# Millionærklubben Eksklusiv - del 1: Hvor meget kan markedet skælve uden helt at falde sammen?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Negative

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is part 1 of a Danish Millionærklubben live panel (Ulrik Bie, Thomas Thysen, Sten Jacobsen). The panel is broadly bearish on US AI-related equities. They argue the data-center capex boom is overbuilt and financed with too much debt, and that credit markets (CDS, Oracle and Nvidia bonds) point to more downside. Europe gets a more constructive view because of its industrial and robotics AI deployment, welfare state and lower debt. They see a structurally weaker dollar ahead, and they think lower rates might delay a crash by 3-12 months without fixing the underlying problem.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ NVDA — Nvidia | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Panel sees the AI capex boom as overbuilt and circularly financed; Thomas tells long-term investors not to own US AI stocks.

#### Reasoning

Thomas (guest, SEB strategist) says long-term investors should not own US AI-related stocks at all; the 'nastier part of a crash' is still ahead, possibly delayed to 2027-28. Sten (guest) says Nvidia acted as the bank for the AI system and can't keep doing so, and its bonds are signalling downside. Ulrik points to circular financing.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-center capex stabilises at slower growth with lower rates
- if AI monetisation produces strong earnings
- if credit spreads and Nvidia bonds recover

> *"hvis du er en langsigtet investor, og du ikke skal slå dit index hver måned, så skal du slet ikke eje amerikanske AI-relaterede aktier"*

---

### ⛔ ORCL — Oracle | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Weakest of the big AI names: ~9% funding cost, heavy debt load, growth claims don't hold up.

#### Reasoning

Sten (guest) calls Oracle the weakest of the large AI names. Its funding rate is about 9% and its reported 20% top-line growth doesn't hold up when examined. Ulrik notes about USD 250bn of planned debt that is hard to pay off from earnings. Credit-rating risk: a downgrade toward junk could hit hard.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Oracle funding spreads tighten materially
- if earnings growth proves sustainable
- if debt load is reduced

> *"der er vi oppe i finansieringsrenten for Oracle, som måske er den svageste af de store. Der er vi oppe i 9% i rentet"*
